purpose: T045's registered intervention test (design scratch/e075_design.md): e073+e074 showed negative-utility cache entries concentrate in the model's OWN generated tokens while corpus-prompt entries ~never hurt. Arms (fixed-anchor 64->512 free run, B=8, e053c net): A-none control; A-self-prune (V-zero own generated entries age>96 every K=32 steps from g~100); A-prompt-prune placebo (V-zero the 63 corpus-prompt entries at matched ages/times); A-both (report-only). FROZEN bars: R1 tail clean CE self <= none+0.01 AND prompt >= none+0.05 (both firing = source-specific pruning value); R2 fluency entropy/top-k drift <= 5%; R3 per-age utility curve after pruning (predict unchanged spike); kill if self costs > +0.05.

seeds.battery: the seed-202 8-draw, ALL 8 prompts (e069's battery A = the first 4 of this same draw; the B=8 extension is the deterministic remainder of the draw — no new seed). Sampling: per-arm seed-7 re-init, shared CPU generator, row order per step (e053b stream math) — arms share the same sampling stream and are token-identical until the first prune affects a draw (g=101). NOTE: with B=8 the row-order stream interleaves 8 rows, so rows 0-3 do NOT replicate battery A's B=4 token stream; the separate B=4 battery-A replica arm (G3) carries protocol identity.

arms.self: V-zero generated entries p in [64, front-97] at each event (age = front - p > 96)
arms.prompt: V-zero prompt entries p in [1, 63] at each event (all have age > 96 at the first event)
arms.both: union of the self and prompt bands

schedule.age_rule: age of entry p at event with front t = t - p > 96 <=> p <= t-97
schedule.timing: prune applied at the TOP of the event iteration, before the decode feeding the next sample; first affected sample g=101 (position 165); all arms token-identical through position 164

prompt.note: position 0 (sequence start, age 511) excluded as in e073/e074

generated.ages: 1..447, restricted to >= the sweep's own a* for the junk census

readouts.r1: on-line clean full-softmax CE of emitted tokens (e053b sample_and_ce quantity), mean over final 64 generation steps; bars: self <= none + 0.01 AND prompt >= none + 0.05; kill: self > +0.05
readouts.r2: per-step full-softmax entropy + top-40 (sampling k) mass (+ top-1 mass and emitted-token rank recorded), tail means; drift bar ±5% for A-self-prune
readouts.r3: final-step 511-position V-zero sweep per arm (clean recompute on the post-pruning stream); registered prediction: unchanged ages-1-5 spike
